_comment: This file is NOT authentication and NOT a security control.
It is a local registry of names, checked against whatever is typed at
Gate 4, so that an unregistered name or a typo is caught before an
approval record is written to the report.
It proves nothing about who was actually sitting at the keyboard.
Anyone with write access to this file can add a name to it.
Treat it as a spell-checker for approver names, not as a gate on identity.
